fields.label: About this section
fields.message:
The pricing shown on /services. Each page has its own pricing, so changing it here does not affect the Home or Reels pages.

A single service can override this with its own pricing: open that Services entry and fill in its Pricing tab. Services that leave it empty show the pricing below.
